description: One Map Policy geoportal (Geoportal Kebijakan Satu Peta) is a data portal run by Geospatial Information Agency (BIG), Indonesia. The geoportal displays the compiled thematic geospatial layers of the One Map Policy, in which ministries such as public works, energy and transport contribute infrastructure and spatial-plan layers, with web map services. Coverage: Indonesia. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as wms, viewer; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("no page title") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support infrastructure and land-use planning studies of Indonesia. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
